name: Wanpaku Tanteidan
summary: A group of young boys (plus a token girl and her little brother, the obligatory brat) form a detective club, pooling their talents for brain, brawn, invention, and driving skills to solve crimes in Tokyo. Much to the consternation of police chief Nakamura, they often succeed where the professionals fail.

name: Dante: Inferno to Paradise
summary: Dante: Inferno to Paradise, by acclaimed filmmaker Ric Burns, explores the riveting life and times of Dante Alighieri (1265-1321) and his soaring masterpiece "The Divine Comedy" – one of the greatest achievements in the history of Western literature.

name: Escaping Utopia
summary: Uncover New Zealand's most extreme religious cult, Gloriavale, and the true stories of people attempting to break free, including current and former members that have never gone on record before.

name: The Synanon Fix
summary: The Synanon Fix the series explores the rise and fall of the controversial treatment center Synanon, which grew from a groundbreaking drug rehabilitation program in the late 1950s into a communal living experiment that would later draw criticism for abuse and cult-like behavior.

name: Morphle and the Magic Pets
summary: Morphle and the Magic Pets follows Mila and her stepbrother, Jordie, as they leap into a world of adventure with the help of Morphle, Mila's magical and loyal pet who has the power to morph into whatever she imagines. The trio use their skills and smarts to keep magic pets out of mischief, solve problems and find ‘magic matches' for each newcomer.

name: Sítio do Picapau Amarelo
summary: The stories of Sítio do Picapau Amarelo are set on the farm of Dona Benta, a friendly lady who lives away from the rush and noise of the city. She counts on the friendship of Tia Nastácia, who cooks delicious delicacies for her and her granddaughter Lúcia, better known as Narizinho. Alongside the inseparable doll Emília, Narizinho is a sweet girl full of dreams, who creates a world of fantasies around her.

name: Doctor Odyssey
summary: Max is the new on-board doctor for a luxury cruise ship where the staff works hard and plays harder. It's all hands on deck as Max and his small but mighty medical team navigate unique medical crises and each other, miles from shore.

name: Good Times Black Again
summary: In this edgy, irreverent reimagining of the TV classic, a new generation of the Evans family keeps their head above water in a Chicago housing project.

previousepisode.name: Gran final Part 3: Mi mejor historia de amor

name: Behind the Drag Queen of the Year Pageant Competition Award Contest Competition
summary: Legendary drag queens Alaska Thunderfuck and her creative drag partner Lola LeCroix are putting together their annual drag pageant, The Drag Queen of the Year Pageant Competition Award Contest Competiton. With a venue in place and rehearsals gearing up, Alaska and Lola have to deal with an unreliable crew, packages not being delivered, and eight drag queen contestants who all have a variety of talent, costumes, and performances. After a nightmare in tech rehearsals and with only hours away from showtime; will these queens get to crown their latest winner?

name: Oblivion Battery
summary: Boukyaku Battery is a story about a famous baseball battery consisting of the genius pitcher Haruka Kiyomine and skilled catcher Kei Kaname who was also known as the "General." During their senior league days, they were talented enough to not only win, but also crush the hopes and dreams of many junior high school players that they played against. However, Kaname lost his memory and the two entered Kotesashi High School, a no-name public high school. In the same school, they meet several talented players who had quit baseball after playing against them in junior high. This is a story of their coming together in a newly established baseball club to play baseball again.

name: The iDOLM@STER Shiny Colors
summary: Hands clasped, hearts alight, our idols take flight! Watch as our wannabe idols band together to forge friendships and pursue their dreams, each with their own unique personalities that light up the screen just as much as the breathtaking visuals and novel storytelling. Embark on a dazzling and heartwarming tale about chasing a shining world.

previousepisode.name: The Brilliance of This Moment Alone

name: Зозулі
summary: The parental house is the only thing that unites three completely different sisters. Famous fashion designer Galya, teacher Oksana and former boxer Valya have not spoken to each other for many years and would be happy not to speak for as long, but the war brought them together under one roof. Sisters have to figure out their relationship with each other and with the surrounding people: former lovers, present and future.

name: How to Be Your Own Best Friend
The Grimm Variations
summary: A Cinderella who delights in pulling strings. A bloodthirsty Little Red Riding Hood in a dystopia. In these grim fairy tales, happy endings are relative.

name: Vienna Game
summary:
Vienna Game is about the Congress of Vienna, following the downfall of Napoleon Bonaparte following his exile to the island of Elba. Kings and crown princes, ministers, spies, noble ladies, mistresses, inventors, artists, and concubines, party and discuss the situation in Vienna. The fate of Europe is then played on the dance floor and in the boudoir.

We see how the delegations of England, Russia, Austria, France, and Prussia contributed to the organization of the Congress, with powerful women using their influence to steer the peace talks. The show is about the political game of luck, money, love, and power against the spectacular backdrop of Vienna.

name: Les disparues de la gare
summary:
Les disparues de la gare is based on a true crime story set in Perpignan, Southern France; between 1995 and 2001, a teenage girl disappeared, and three young women were murdered around the train station. They are young, beautiful and driven by a strong desire for emancipation. Their faces are displayed in the newspapers. They become "Les Disparues de la gare".

Flore Robin, a young investigator, took her first steps with the police on the same day that the first body was found. She will have to team up with police captain Franck Vidal and his mentor Felix Sabueso, who were long put in the closet but were given special attention to this out-of-the-box. At the same time, the mother of the missing girl explores each avenue to find her daughter. For 20 years, when a real psychosis gradually hits the city, the hunt for a ruthless serial killer is raging.

name: Kaulitz & Kaulitz
summary: Bill and Tom Kaulitz bring us close to their life as Tokio Hotel frontmen, podcast hosts and close-knit twins, and to the highs and lows of fame.

name: Buying London
summary: Property mogul Daniel Daggers and his ambitious team of agents at DDRE Global take on and challenge London's luxury property market in this brand-new Netflix series, Buying London. The talented team set out to conquer the super prime high-end real estate market from the prestigious streets of Mayfair to the exclusive enclaves of Holland Park as we follow the group as they navigate the intricacies of their personal lives as well as striving to make their mark in the glamorous world of luxury real estate.

name: ARK: The Animated Series
summary: 21st century paleontologist Helena Walker finds herself resurrected on a mysterious primeval island populated by prehistoric beasts.

name: Renovate or Rebuild
summary: The idea of Renovating or Rebuilding your home is a hard call to make. James Treble along with some very talented designers help homeowners make this arduous decision.

name: Ryan's Four
summary: A doctor guides four interns through the rigors of training at a medical center.

name: Morphle
summary: Follow the adventures of Mila and her pet Morphle.

name: Sez Les
summary: Sez Les was the TV show that firmly establish Les Dawson's reputation, running for over seven years and bringing his dour, miserabilist humour to a wider viewing public. Featuring a running guest spot for comedy legend John Cleese alongside stalwart sideman Roy Barraclough, these shows offer more world-weary humour and hilarious sketches.

name: Фаворит
summary: based on the famous novel by Valentin Pikul. During the rule of Peter III , who came to the throne after the death of Empress Elizabeth, was short-lived. Peter III set up an army against him with his hastily reforms, and was deposed by a military rebellion. Catherine became the empress.

name: You Are My Whole World
summary: It tells a delicious, interesting and sweet story about Acha, a little palace maid from Xuanwu City who loves food and is quirky. When she went out of the palace to look for ingredients, she picked up the young master He Lianyu who was ambushed and was in a coma, which led to a delicious, interesting and sweet story. Acha and He Lianyu, whose status is completely different, are entangled because of food. In a series of ridiculous events, the two develop a sweet love and pursue their own dreams and goals.

name: Lootere
summary: Off the coast of Somalia, when the passengers of an ill-fated ship are taken hostages by pirates, an unlikely hero must step forward to save them all.

name: Fuyu no Semi
summary: During the late Tokugawa period, tensions between the bakufu and Chōshū clan are rising due to arguments over how to deal with foreigners in Japan. However, unlike the rest of the Chōshū clan members, Touma Kusaka wants Japan to develop good relations with foreign nations. To achieve this, he attempts to learn English behind his clan's back. A man named Keiichirou Akizuki decides to become Kusaka's teacher, but their relationship soon grows into something stronger, despite the fact that Akizuki works for Kusaka's clan's enemy, the Tokugawa bakufu.

name: Le monde n'existe pas
summary: Adam Vollmann is 40 years old, he is a journalist for the web editorial staff of a major national daily newspaper. One morning, the portrait of Axel Challe, designated as the main suspect in the murder of a young girl, in Guerches-sur-Isoire, appears on the television screen in front of him. When he insisted to his editor-in-chief to go straight away to report there, he explained to him that he was from there, that he grew up there. What he doesn't say is that he knows Axel Challe well: he was his friend. Even more, Axel Challe was the demigod of his childhood.

name: Bouchon
summary: Lolo is an actress and works hard to get there. She has just landed the leading role in a feature film. The apotheosis. When his father learns that he has cancer, and reacts to it like a child, the machine jams and everything goes wrong. His quest for serenity will transform into a quest for identity.

name: Groeien en bloeien
summary: The garden center 'Groeien en Bloeien' is run by the warm but chaotic Versmissen family.

name: The Dawson Watch
summary: Les Dawson and a team of assistants take a light hearted look at some of the problems of modern day society.

name: Dawson's Weekly
summary: British situation comedy with Les Dawson taking a different character each week and showing his story.

name: The Les Dawson Show
summary: A variety show hosted by Les Dawson featuring sketch comedy, as well as stand up comedy, guest appearances, dance numbers and musical performances.

name: Hagen
summary: The series follows Hagen, a soldier and Lord Commander loyal to King Gunter, who secretly harbors a deep love for the monarch's daughter, Princess Kriemhild. When the Huns threaten to invade and a legendary dragon slayer, Siegfried, arrives, the king decides to marry a new wife, a mystical Valkyrie queen called Brunhild and calls on the help of both Siegfried and Hagen.

name: Sphinx
summary: Early one morning, 14-year-old Minke Moorman is kidnapped. Three years later she reappears out of nowhere, completely feral and with a mysterious wing tattoo on her back. After her return, the entire family comes under pressure. Minke has been changed by her traumatic experience and, without anyone knowing, she is still being played by her captor from the shadows.

name: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
summary: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed calls on the world's leading experts to crack thousand-year-old puzzles where the cause of death could be accident, murder, suicide—and even ritual sacrifice.

name: Mauvais joueurs
summary: Starting from nothing, 13 players compete for a spot in a luxury villa and a shot at 150,000 euros in this unpredictable game of strategy and survival.

name: Le château de mes rêves
summary: Who has never dreamed of castle life? 7 families without personal fortune have taken the plunge and have become castellans! But this dream has a price, and these new kind of lords have given up everything to change their lives and open guest rooms, organize weddings or set up prodigious events, the only way for them to finance and maintain their exceptional areas! Come and share the extraordinary daily life of these new squires!

name: Insoupçonnable
summary: A psychiatrist expert in serial killers becomes passionate about a famous French cold case recently solved. As he digs deeper into the file, as the police officers of the time delve into their memories, a dizzying affair worthy of the dark tale of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde reveals itself.

previousepisode.name: La retraite d'un tueur en série

name: Skyhawks
summary: Daring air-sea rescues, secret missions, sky-diving thrills and fast-paced excitement come your way as Cap. Wilson and his Sky Hawks take off on new, weekly adventures.

name: Grand Indian Hotel
summary: One of the most exclusive hotel groups in the world throws open its doors to reveal the pursuit of luxury and VIP perfection.

name: The Underdog: Josh Must Win
summary: Can Nick Grimshaw, Vicky Pattison, Amber Gill and Pete Wicks secretly rig a reality show to make average guy Josh the winner among a polished cast of contestants? If Josh wins, everyone wins!

name: Design Goals
summary: Designers Brittany and Annie turn homeowners' inspirations into beautiful renovations while staying on schedule and within budget. Along with their A-team of builders, these best friends help bring their clients' dreams to life.

name: Interrogation Files
summary: Spotlights techniques used to uncover revelations in the pursuit of justice.

name: L.O.L. Surprise! Tots Road Trip
summary: Meet Royal Bee, Lady Diva, Swag, and Neonlicious, our favorite LOL Surprise Tots! These tots are always on the go. Find them at Royal Bee's Diner, The House of Surprises, Prince Bee's Mall of Surprises or even at the Recording Studio in this fun L.O.L. Surprise! cartoon for kids!

name: L.O.L. Surprise! Family
summary: LOL Surprise! Join us for surprising episodes featuring friends from the whole LOL Surprise family!

name: True Crime Story: Smugshot
summary: A docu-series that spotlights entitled individuals involved in elaborate criminal behavior. At times quirky and funny, at others outrageous or disturbing, these are the stories of people who thought they could, or should, get away with it.

name: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers the Dragon Emperor
summary: Jill breaks out of prison the night before she's set to be executed by her fiancé, Crown Prince Gerald. She's struck by an arrow while escaping, but instead of dying, she's transported six years into the past—to the night she and Gerald met. Desperate to alter fate, she instead proposes to the first man she sees, Hadis Teos Rave, her enemy in the future. This is her last chance to get it right!

previousepisode.name: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers the Dragon Emperor

name: ATRI: My Dear Moments
summary: "As the world sank, I found you." In the near future, a sudden and unexplained sea rise has left much of human civilization underwater. In a little town slowly being enveloped by the ocean, an unforgettable summer is about to begin for a boy and a mysterious robot girl...

name: Pecado
summary: A young girl falls for a priest, will the love be stronger than religion?

name: Why Nobody Remembers My World?
summary: The story is set in a world in which humanity triumphed over other races in a war for hegemony. However, this is rewritten with a new reality where humanity lost the war of the five races, and its hero Sid is nowhere to be found. Only a young boy named Kai is aware of this change, and other humans seem to have forgotten his existence. After meeting the mysterious Rinne, Kai resolves to go against humanity's altered fate.

previousepisode.name: Those Who Shatter the Endless Cycle of World Reincarnation

name: STEVE! (martin) a documentary in 2 pieces
summary: Steve Martin is one of the most beloved and enigmatic figures in entertainment. Dive into his extraordinary story from two distinct points of view—past and present—as Martin reflects on how his beginnings led to his unexpectedly fulfilling life today.

name: Telephone Time
summary: Telephone Time is an anthology drama series. The series features plays adapted from short stories by John Nesbitt.

name: Adventure Gold Diggers
summary: Adventure Gold Diggers follows three hardcore gold prospecting teams as they venture into dangerous and inhospitable territories across the country to unearth gold.

name: Tren Atlantico
summary: Explores the rugged and rich landscapes of Spain and Portugal via rail routes located on their Atlantic coast.

name: Playing House
summary: It tells the story of online editor He Luyan and hotel entrepreneur Qi Lin who time-traveled into the complaints written by He Luyan at the same time. One became an undercover guest room manager and the other became the hotel president. After experiencing battles of wits and betrayal, they walked hand in hand and finally ended up together. A fantasy love story that goes both ways in real life.

name: Blue Box
summary:
Taiki Inomata, a third-year student in junior high, attends Eimei Academy, an integrated school with a major sports program. Having joined the high school badminton team, Taiki tries to attend open practice as early as possible. But no matter how early he goes, he always arrives second in the gymnasium. The person one step ahead of him is Chinatsu Kano, a first-year student in senior high and Taiki's crush.

Chinatsu is the rising star of the basketball team, and the gap between her and Taiki could not be greater. Although Taiki is a decent badminton player, his popularity is nowhere near Chinatsu's, making it even less likely for his feelings to be reciprocated. However, in a strange twist of fate, she ends up living in Taiki's house!

Wanting to become a worthy match for Chinatsu, Taiki pursues the same dream as his crush: to partake in the Nationals. Taiki starts training harder than ever before, all for the sake of building a strong relationship with his new housemate.

name: Полицейские будни
summary: A year has passed since the adoption of the law "On the Police," but the country still laughs at the "renaming"; the majority of citizens do not believe in real changes in the structures of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. To prove the effectiveness of the reform, the authorities decide to send a film crew to the first police department. A serial film about the work of Russian cops will tell about real folk heroes!

name: Mind Over Maddie
summary: Mind Over Maddie focuses on an ordinary 14 year-old girl Maddie, and the three personality types that live inside her brain, guiding (and misguiding) every decision she makes.

name: Barneavdelingen
summary: The series follows patients, parents and staff through adversity, success, grief and joy at Oslo University Hospital.

name: Fry Me to the Moon
summary: Lu Zhenzhen, who took his career very seriously, risked his own life and returned to Chengdu for love. Her best friend Gu Manting, who married her childhood sweetheart early but always wanted to escape from the marriage, invited Zhenzhen to join her time-honored hotel "Sichuan Bailou". The original life trajectory of the two was broken by the sudden appearance of catering entrepreneur Liang Qingran... The sudden crisis in Sichuan Bailou made three women with different personalities "unable to get acquainted without fighting." After many tests of love, career, and ideals, what choices will they make in the fireworks of Chengdu?

name: The Heiress Luo Wanwan
summary: On the night of their wedding, the daughter of a minister and the son of the prime minister were both involved in the murder of the Ghostly Bride. They were waiting to meet again. One was the boss of a marriage fraud organization suspected of murder, and the other was the young minister of Dali Temple who caught the murderer.

name: The Rebel Empress
summary: It told the story of Empress Wang Yunci who was murdered in the fire and reborn inside Jiang Jinli's body as the Princess Consort Duan because of an ancient jade. Her birthday just became her death day, and her brother-in-law also became her husband. At first, she mistakenly thought that Prince Duan murdered her for treason, so she was determined to seek revenge. However, she always felt concern and protection from Prince Duan. So let's see how these two people with different intentions change, from using each other to giving heart and completing their long-cherished wishes while receiving love.

name: The Dangerous Lover
summary: In the chess game, Hu Tian foresaw the outcome of the entire Hu family being slaughtered. In order to change his fate, Tian Tian Lalang and the downtrodden prince Su Yanli, who had a "rebirth" experience, tried to guide the villain brother to do good. Unexpectedly, Su Yanli might be The culprit who wiped out the Hu family, the two are in extreme tension, Tiantian slowly learns about Su Yanli and her fateful origins.

name: Love In a Dream
summary: Suffering from a mysterious illness, noble concubine Su Qin encounters a black-robed kidnapper "Bing-zhong-bing" in the palace. To marry Lu Huan, Prince Ningan and plot regicide, they face danger together, their bond growing amid turmoil.

name: Step by Step Love
summary: The story unfolds with the encounter of the space designer Bu Ran and Lu Cenyang, a boss with matching design talents. Going through challenges, they both treaded steadily and resolutely on the path to chasing their dreams. Despite various adversities, they remained passionate and true to their hearts, and earned valuable rewards within their industry.

name: Sacrifice for Love
summary: In the turbulent era of the Republic of China, an ordinary murder of a dancing girl unexpectedly stirred up the dark forces in Nancheng. Gu Manqing has been dependent on her sister who was a dancer since she was a child, but she never thought that on her big day, she would witness Lu Yichuan murder her sister. After Gu Manqing failed to assassinate Lu Yichuan on their wedding night, she jumped out of the window and escaped, and then started a new life incognito. I thought that Gu Manqing could live a happy life by marrying into a wealthy family, but unexpectedly, this was Gu Manqing's first step in revenge, becoming a stepmother in Lu Yichuan's family. Gu Man, who risked the rest of his life at all costs, launched a fatal revenge against Lu Yichuan, but when he was about to kill his enemy, he discovered that there was a bigger conspiracy hidden behind it...

name: Enslaved by Love
summary: Xie Yun, daughter of the Xie family, once knew and loved Yin Ji, but was misunderstood as the one who betrayed Yin Ji and married the Qi King. After Yin Ji ascended to the throne, he began to retaliate against Xie Yun, making her live a hellish life in the palace. Despite the love-hate entanglement with Yin Ji, Xie Yun still held onto her true feelings. Together, they foiled the conspiracy of traitors.

name: The Missing Snowflakes
summary: Lin Huanhuan and Lin Shangshang are twins. The younger sister Huanhuan was sent to the mountains to learn medical skills when she was a child. Many years later, her sister Shang Shang fell in love with the prince. Unexpectedly, the queen deliberately married Shang Shang to the prince Shangguan Li. Lin Shang Shang committed suicide by hanging for this reason. Lin Huanhuan was forced to marry on her sister's behalf, starting a cohabitation life where enemies met on a narrow road!

name: Why is He Still Single?
summary: A story about a man who seems eccentric but is, in truth, kindhearted, and how the world ultimately accepts him. Through the portrayal of a man with extreme quirks, the film delivers endless humor and sharp banter while prompting reflection on human nature and our relationship with the world. He's a man who loves life but, in his forties, declares himself a "non-marrier". Is he the adored male idol surrounded by admirers, or the straight man women steer clear of? Is it that he doesn't want to marry, or can't? When this quirky bachelor finally meets the woman of his dreams, how will he handle it and will he win her heart in the end? As the saying goes, "There is no fixed flavor in food; what suits the taste is the best". Likewise, there's no man who truly refuses marriage, only one who hasn't yet met the right match.

name: Strange Notes
summary: In a bustling district, a House of Wonders variety store has opened, where items, seemingly ordinary, each possess peculiar functions. The owner, Damon, has documented the instructions for use in the Wonders Notebook, allowing customers to select items based on their needs. People from all walks of life flock to the House of Wonders, each facing their own dilemmas and seeking ways to overcome them. However, in the end, they invariably discover that what truly resolves their issues isn't these strange and curious goods, but rather their own love and faith.

name: Filter
summary: The "Filter Bracelet" gives ordinary Su Chengcheng the power to change her appearance, allowing her to help others as personas like "Su Miao," "Dr. Fang Jin," and "Quan Shengtang." Tang Qi falls for each persona, but Su Chengcheng's lies to hide her secret lead him to heartbreak and worsening vision. Eventually, he discovers her true identity, realizing his love is for Su Chengcheng herself. Together, they promote "natural beauty" through their brand "Chirping Birds." In the end, Su Chengcheng learns that true beauty lies in authenticity and hard work toward happiness.

name: A Thousand Miles to Your Heart
summary: Qi Zhi, the Imperial Chicken Keeper, is appointed by the Emperor as a secret imperial inspector, tasked with searching across the land for a prince worthy of inheriting the throne. Along the way, he forms an unlikely partnership with the Crown Prince and Princess Ouyang Yan of the Yan Kingdom. Together, they unravel one "conspiracy" after another, sparking a series of hilarious and absurd misadventures. In the end, each of them comes to understand their own heart's true desire and the weight of the responsibilities they must shoulder.

name: Fateful Love
summary: Through unexpected circumstances, an illegitimate daughter crosses paths with the God of War. As she is forcibly pulled into disputes involving the nation, the two pit wits and will against various factions. An irrevocable change in her identity leads Han Zi Jing to Jun Bei Ye, a prince known as the God of War for his prowess in battle. He has chosen her even though she is merely the illegitimate daughter of the prime minister. He may seem ruthless and domineering, but he is willing to devote everything to protect her.

name: Lethally Blonde
summary: Lethally Blonde offers insight into tragic stories ripped straight from the headlines, exposing the dark side of people pursuing beauty and fame.

previousepisode.name: To Live and Die in Hotlanta

name: She and Her Girls
summary: Zhang Guimei, a middle school teacher from China's mountainous west, saw many of her female students drop out of school due to poverty, often ending up in early marriages or labor, which deeply pained her. Determined to change this, she founded a free girls' high school in 2008 to give these girls a chance at education, allowing them to attend college and escape their circumstances. Despite starting with no teachers, students, funds, or experience, Zhang lead the teachers and students achieved the remarkable: every student, despite their initial academic struggles, successfully entered college. The school has transformed the lives of countless girls, changing their fates. However, as the school's reputation grew and more impoverished girls from the mountains applied, new challenges and difficulties emerged.

name: Love on the Turquoise Land
summary: After visiting an exhibition inspired by the "Classic of Mountains and Seas," author Nie Xi pens an urban fantasy novel brimming with Eastern aesthetics. It follows the unlikely bond between Nie Jiuluo, the wild blade of the covert folk organization "Nanshan Hunters," and Yan Tuo, a righteous man who has endured years of humiliation. From initial clashes to life-saving collaborations, they develop mutual trust and affection, joining forces to battle the sinister "Dixiao" and protect love and peace, ultimately finding their way to each other.

name: Such A Good Love
summary: It tells the story of when the most righteous female lead meets the most talented male lead, facing an uncertain future. In the entanglement of fate for over a decade, they use passionate love to resist doubts and answer the ultimate question of whether love is worth it.

name: Forever Young
summary: In the 1980s, Ma Ding grew up in the hutongs of Beijing with three sworn brothers. On the eve of their high school graduation, an incident triggered by Ma Ding fractures their bond. With youth's end, he drifts into obscurity abroad. Years later, now a vice president of a listed company, Ma Ding is diagnosed with a brain tumor. Preparing to face death alone, a lingering attachment he cannot sever pulls him back. He returns to resolve old grievances and reclaim lost friendship. The four middle-aged brothers embark on a new venture together. As their lives transform, the embers of their past camaraderie slowly rekindle, reigniting Ma Ding's will to live.

name: The Glory
summary: Zhuang Han Yan, abandoned and raised in the southern countryside since childhood, eventually returns to the Zhuang family in the capital, attracting the attention of Fu Yun Xi. Fu Yun Xi is afflicted with a strange illness and seeks to marry a woman of both virtue and talent to entrust his family and friends. Zhuang Han Yan, with her exceptional courage and kind heart, becomes his ideal choice. As Zhuang Han Yan and Fu Yun Xi fall in love during their mutual testing and maneuvering, Han Yan reconciles with her mother, rediscovering the lost family bond. In her interactions with the Fu family, Zhuang Han Yan experiences the warmth of a family and the beauty of affection. Together, Zhuang Han Yan and Fu Yun Xi expose the hypocritical and unjust actions of Zhuang Shi Yang, the head of the Zhuang family, and become a loving couple.

name: My Name is Zhao Chuxi
summary: Zhao Chuxi, an orphan, was born in Wanjing Mountain and raised under the care of Li Chengqian, a principal. The deaths of Ping'an and Li Chengqian hit him hard, leading him to decide to honor Li Chengqian's last wishes. Determined to improve conditions in his village and prevent further loss of loved ones due to poor transportation, he leaves the village for Jia City to work for money. Upon arriving in Jia City, Zhao Chuxi remains true to his values despite the temptations of a materialistic world. His kindness and willingness to help others have given his boss, Su Xiluo, a strong sense of security, and she gradually develops feelings for him. However, this has also drawn the resentment and retaliation of Xu Shaoqing. With the support and sacrifices of his friends, Zhao Chuxi manages to escape Jia City and arrives in Sanjiang. Yet, everything he has worked for over the past two years is instantly lost. This turning point, however, becomes a catalyst for his true growth. After overcoming numerous challenges, Zhao Chuxi eventually becomes the chairman of Sanjiang Group. He then returns to Jia City, determined to seek justice for Li Chengqian. Having achieved success and recognition, he finally returns to Phoenix Village to fulfill his original dream and the long-cherished wish of Li Chengqian.

name: Dear Enemy
summary: Luo Man and Chen Kai Xi were college classmates. After graduation, the two gradually drifted apart. One became a successful screenwriter, and the other became a rich housewife. Real and fake best friends of ten years meet again; they don't want the other person to have a bad life, nor do they want the other person to have a good life. Luo Man is not satisfied with her career and hopes to achieve a leap in life through marriage and become equal to Chen Kai Xi, who is deeply stuck in the quagmire of marriage. When the undercurrent between the two was raging, the young and beautiful Zhong Qing Cheng became a key figure in the contest between the two.

name: The Miniature Wife
summary: The Miniature Wife is a dramedy examining the power (im)balances between spouses Lindy and Les after a technological accident induces the ultimate relationship crisis.

name: Moonlit Reunion
summary: Beneath Chang'an lies hidden intrigue, where secret heirs return only at midnight. An aloof gentleman and a reckless noblewoman live double lives—lovers by day, fierce rivals by night—all to protect peace in the land and safeguard a harmonious realm.

name: The Glamorous Night
summary: Beneath the revelry of a grand feast, long-hidden undercurrents come to the surface, awakening those who have been pretending to sleep and triggering a survival crisis for various individuals at GST Winery. With everything at stake, every move must be made with extreme caution. Seven key figures, each deeply entangled in the unfolding events, play different roles, revealing the complexity of human nature and the harshness of reality. Through their stories, a common theme emerges: how to stay optimistic and survive in a world filled with uncertainty and fear.

name: The Bald Man
summary: Jia Fugui, who determined to become a top master, established the famous Makino Gang at the age of 18. But now, at the age of 26, he has been misunderstood as a second-rate supporting actor because of his premature baldness, and has been repeatedly despised. So the ashamed Jia Fugui and the loyal second master Tang Lin embarked on the road to find the secret book of hair growth.

name: Hidden Master
summary: Born with a fierce appearance but a kind heart, Gou Lingfeng dreams of becoming a great hero. However, he accidentally learns demonic skills and begins his journey in the martial world. Though facing prejudice and hardships, he never gives up on his dream. Along the way, he becomes friends with Ma Yingdan, the Floral Knight from Poison Valley, and Zhuge Heng, the son of the Sword Saint. After solving many mysterious cases with them and bringing justice to the martial world, he gradually learns the truth, "Justice comes in all forms, and martial arts bear no label of good or evil." In the end, he really becomes a true hero.

name: The Studio
summary: As movies struggle to stay alive and relevant, Matt and his core team of infighting executives battle their own insecurities as they wrangle narcissistic artists and craven corporate overlords in the ever-elusive pursuit of making great films. With their power suits masking their never-ending sense of panic, every party, set visit, casting decision, marketing meeting, and award show presents them with an opportunity for glittering success or career-ending catastrophe. As someone who eats, sleeps, and breathes movies, it's the job Matt's been pursuing his whole life, and it may very well destroy him.

name: Andi Oliver's Fabulous Feasts
summary: Andi Oliver uses her passion for parties to create eight fabulous feasts, which unite communities and tell the incredible story of the people and places she visits.

name: The Interrogation Tapes
summary: The Interrogation Tapes: A Special Edition of 20/20 is a new true-crime docuseries looking at some of the most compelling criminal cases in recent history through the lens of interrogations, unveiling the tricks of the trade detectives use to coax confessions from suspects.

previousepisode.name: Stranger Than Fiction: The Murder of Angie Dodge

name: Ufo-mysteriet med Felix Herngren
summary: The Swedish famous TV-Profile, actor and director Felix Herngren travels both USA and Sweden together with journalist, writer and Ufologist Clas Svahn with the goal of answering the questions behind the mysterious world-wide phenomenon of UFOs.

name: Phaen Luang Buang Maya
summary: When Neenara gets her hands on what she thinks is a pebble, she decides to keep it and forgets about it. Little did she know it was actually a priceless rough diamond that belongs to a big mafia boss. When she starts being chased by those who are after the diamond, the only person who can protect her is Nagun, the man who broke her heart three years ago. Nagun's case requires a believable decoy, so he and Neenara must team up. Their relationship is supposed to end when the case is closed, but Neenara has a few tricks to pull.

name: Friends Like Her
summary: The psychological drama, written by Sarah-Kate Lynch, explores a friendship that turns toxic when a surrogacy deal goes wrong between two best friends who are facing very different futures in Kaikoura when the town is already divided by a catastrophic earthquake.

name: Prai Payakorn
summary: Life and death are chasing Phumin's life. Pinchanida must erase the rumors about fortune tellers and prove herself by finding the important item he wanted.

name: Happy Birthday BBC Two
summary: To celebrate BBC Two's 50th birthday stars and programme makers come together to look back at the story of the channel.

previousepisode.name: Harry and Paul's Story of the Twos

name: This Love Doesn't Have Long Beans
summary: Model Plawan has been a pad kaprao—no long beans—enthusiast all his life. Offered a hefty sum, he's hired to train in a competition at a well-known chef's table restaurant under head chef Chef Oab. His secret mission is to make Chef Oab fall for him and and to become his successor. Unfortunately, he's shaken by the harsh and stern-looking chef who smells like holy basil. Apart from being known for his skills in the kitchen, he's also said to be a serious perfectionist, instilling fear even in his peers. How, then, can amateur Plawan hope to measure up?

name: La vie devant
summary: An almost functional family flows almost peaceful days by procrastinating on almost important issues. While a stroke strikes Valeria, its central pillar, this Smala realizes that it is not immune to the drama. Under the gaze of little Lucas, intrigued by funny adults who ask themselves funny questions, the group will be forced to ask them more essential - and by the way, to mature.

name: Part For Ever
summary: After lurking in the shadows for many years, Ling Xiao undergoes a transformation and becomes the powerful new city lord. Driven by vengeance, he forces Su Wan'er, the daughter of the former city lord, to become his pawn. Despite the deep-rooted enmity between them, they find themselves entangled in a web of love and hate amidst numerous plights and moments of protecting one another. What does the future have in store for them?

name: Киберпапа
summary:
Ignat, a professional welder, is fired from the factory because of a ridiculous case. Since his wife Marina is losing all her family savings in a financial pyramid scheme, the hard worker has to look for alternative sources of income. Stepson Sanya offers his stepfather to participate in an esports tournament with a prize of two million rubles.

Ignat joins the team, but not only for the sake of money, but to establish a relationship with his stepson. He gets to know the life of teenagers from the inside, helps solve problems and becomes for them not just a "meme" uncle, but a real mentor, friend and cyber dad.

name: Get Squiggling!
summary: Join Squiglet as he draws pictures with his Squiggle Stick and Pad.

name: Get Squiggling! Letters
summary:
Squiglet loves squiggling letters and he's going to show the viewers how to squiggle them too!

Squiglet lives in a white world, however it doesn't stay white for long. In this series Squiglet shows the audience how write a different letter of the alphabet everyday.

name: Kaew Khon Lek
summary: Mekhin is a immortal spirit who's been asleep for a long time. He was awaken by a spell, and is now back for his revenge and love from the past. The only thing that can stop him is Kaew Khon Lek, a stone which can destroy spirits.

name: Wang Nang Hong
summary: Pikul is a ghost out for revenge against the male lead and his family. In the past life they were lovers but she thought he killed her. So she stayed as a ghost while he was reborn as the grandson of his past self. His family is cursed and they have to sacrifice a woman or else their family will be destroyed.

name: The Tale of Skyward Sword
summary: Khunpol, a young archaeologist, and descendant of Khunphaen, goes in search of his missing grandfather. He ends up entering the village and meets Molin. Together, alongside some friends, they embark on an adventure through the mystical forest full of supernatural beings and soon they discover the secrets of the past that unites them.

name: Ji Xiang Unhappy
summary: The spirit maiden Jixiang descends the mountain in search of the precious Myriad Spirits Pearl, unwittingly stirring up memories with the human lad Ye Zhou. As she aids Ye Zhou in tracking down the whereabouts of the wicked wolf spirit, Jixiang and Ye Zhou gradually grow to know and love each other. Alongside reclaiming the Myriad Spirits Pearl, Jixiang also transforms from a naive spirit maiden into a worthy queen of her race.

name: Undercover Affair
summary: A Sen from Kuntai Group met the bartender Ling Yi at a bar, and the two have had an intersection since then. During their exchanges, A Sen learned about Ling Yi's pain of being abandoned by her boyfriend after being imprisoned for manslaughter, and had already closed off her emotions. But Asen was really moved by the kind girl in front of him.

name: Live Surgery Room
summary: The arrival of the genius doctor, Zheng Ren, shattered the already chaotic atmosphere of the Haicheng Hospital. His purpose was to uncover an injustice that occurred eighteen years ago here in this hospital. Su Yun, the slacker Head of the Emergency Department, formed a pair of "joyful rivals" with Zheng Ren. Amidst love and conflict, they triumphed over numerous tough medical cases one after another, embarking on a medical journey that was awesome, dynamic, cool, and vibrant.As time went by, Zheng Ren not only uncovered the "cruel truth" of the past but also formed a challenging task force for conjoined

name: Sea of Dreams
summary: It tells the story of ice sculpture artist Yan Dong who attracted the interest of a high-dimensional alien civilization from the universe - a "cryogenic artist" when he participated in the Ice Sculpture Art Festival. Inspired by Yan Dong's ice sculptures, he drained all the earth's oceans and formed a huge ice ring around the earth in orbit, thus creating a cosmic-scale ice sculpture. Dong named the ice ring "Sea of Dreams". Since then, the ocean has left the earth's surface and hung in the sky. Humanity has lost the ocean on which it depends for survival, causing an unprecedented survival crisis. Yan Dong decided to work with other scientists to overcome technical difficulties and bring the ocean back to the earth.

name: A Better Life
summary: 39-year-old insurance agent Hu Manli, who rose from humble beginnings and fought her way up in society, suddenly faces underhanded competition at the peak of her career, with both her professional and personal life thrown into turmoil. The mastermind behind it all turns out to be 28-year-old Xue Xiaozhou, a down-and-out rich heir who had just entered the insurance industry. After several confrontations, the two uncover the truth behind their conflict, gradually resolve their misunderstandings, and decide to join forces. Through clashes of values and shared experiences in the trials of life, they form an unbeatable partnership, becoming both mentor and friend to each other while achieving business success and discovering their true selves.

name: Enforcement Department
summary: Qi Lin is a judge of the Qinggang Intermediate Court. He was transferred from the Criminal Court to the Enforcement Bureau by accident. His leader is Chu Yun, who was quite prejudiced against him due to work misunderstandings. At first, Qi Lin did not cooperate well with the team. However, after experiencing the "luxury car hit-and-run case", "divorce house vacation case", "shared bicycle deposit case", "college student naked loan case", "ten thousand tons of grain enforcement case" and other work tempered, Qi Lin has become more and more interested in enforcement. He gained a profound understanding of the "emotion, reason, and law" in the novel, and gradually developed a love for Chu Yun. The Qinggang Intermediate People's Court decided to hand over the difficult problem of the development of the Global International Center, a key municipal project, the "Changsheng Village vacation case" to Chu Yun's team.

name: Light to the Night
summary: In 1997, a disappearance inside an elevator pulls detectives He Yuanhang and Ran Fangxu into a twisted mystery. Facing doubt and confusion along the way, they press on to uncover the truth. As time moves on, they heal from life's uncertainties, hold fast to justice, and rise above hardship with resilience and hope.

name: ELSE!
summary: A warm, honest and unpredictable talk show with Else Kåss Furuseth. Every week she is visited by famous guests in the studio.

previousepisode.name: Sikker på at du ikke tar piller?

name: The Pitt
summary: The Pitt is a realistic examination of the challenges facing healthcare workers in today's America as seen through the lens of the frontline heroes working in a modern-day hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Each episode follows an hour of Dr. Robby's 15-hour shift as the chief attendant in Pittsburgh Trauma Medical Hospital's emergency room.

name: Tell No One
summary: An arrest operation that both succeeds and fails changes everyone's fate. Waiting in agony means never giving up, and those unspeakable crimes are also waiting for an opportunity to return. This time, it is the final battle between good and evil!

name: Atrapados
summary: Reporter Ema Garay gains visibility amongst digital journalism by catching criminals who tend to evade justice in Bariloche city, in Patagonia Argentina. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets Leo Mercer, a social worker and referent, who ends up being the main suspect of her investigation on the disappearance of a 16 year old girl. While Ema tries to discover the truth, she will have to confront herself.

name: The White Olive Tree
summary: This series is adapted from Jiu Yuexi's novel of the same name. During an interview mission in the turbulent East Country, Liang City satellite TV's female reporter Song Ran encounters danger. Fortunately, she is rescued by Li Zan, a Chinese explosive engineer who volunteers in the East Country. Li Zan's gentleness and childlike heart deeply attracts Song Ran. Through multiple interactions with Song Ran, Li Zan also realizes that though she appears weak on the outside, she's actually brave and strong, with a heart filled with justice and kindness. With the same ideals and compatible souls, a spark of love ignites between the two. However, a sudden bombing attack puts a halt to this nascent relationship. After returning to China, both of them hit low points in their lives and even lose contact with each other. They are both suffering physically and mentally as Li Zan feels guilty and blames himself for the death of his friend who sacrificed his life to save him in the bombing attack, while Song Ran gets into a controversy due to a photo which she took during the bombing attack. By chance, they reunite and their lives gradually return to normal. Together, they plant the seeds of the white olive tree.

name: In the Name of the Brother
summary: In 1944 Harbin, under the puppet Manchukuo regime, Song Zhuowen, an underground party member disguised as a railway patrol officer, is mistakenly recognized by the head of the special service section, Guan Xue, as his life-saving benefactor—actually Zhuowen's long-lost twin brother, Song Zhuowu. Zhuowen, aiming to uncover the ultimate mission of Kwantung Army section chief Asano Daigo's visit to Harbin, devises a plan to use Guan Xue to infiltrate the special service section. However, the sudden appearance of Zhuowu puts Zhuowen in an unexpected predicament. Guan Xue, cold-blooded and suspicious, and Zhuowu, impulsive by nature, often inadvertently sabotages Zhuowen's operations. It's only through the arrangement of their superiors that the two brothers start to cooperate and protect each other. After several tests, avoiding the open and covert struggles among their colleagues in the special service section, they finally earn the trust of Guan Xue and the Japanese officials. Within this short year, the underground party members, after enduring immense hardships, manage to uncover and thwart a secret operation jointly plotted by the Japanese army and the Soviet Union, expose the puppet Manchukuo spies lurking within their party, and welcome the final victory of the war.

name: Imperfect Women
summary: An unconventional, psychological thriller about a crime that shatters the lives of a decades-long friendship of three women. As the investigation unravels, so does the truth about how even the closest relationships can change over time.

name: Two Marriages
summary: Two suburban Iowa couples are next-door neighbors, but their marriages are vastly different.

name: The Cuckoo
summary:
Jessica, Nick, and their daughter, Alice, relocate to the countryside, hoping to leave financial struggles and family conflicts behind. The family take in a lodger, Sian, who befriends Jessica and Alice but triggers suspicion in Nick.

As seeds of discord are sown and quickly bloom to reveal dark secrets, Alice and Sian grow closer, but Sian's troubled past could be edging the family towards a disastrous future, and in a race against time, Jessica and Nick must fight to preserve everything they hold dear…

name: Make It Big
summary: Series following twelve children from the ages of 11 to 13 who are given the chance to run a business for six weeks with a budget of 5,000 pounds and a fully-equipped office.

name: The Midnight Romance in Hagwon
summary: A secret and sweet real-life romance between veteran academy instructor Seo Hye Jin and her flirty student Lee Joon Ho, who returns after 10 years and stirs her heart.

name: The Vise
summary: Originally a suspense anthology, the show eventually became focused solely on the adventures of a one-armed private detective based in London.

name: The Litchi Road
summary: The story follows Li Shande, a man deceived by his colleagues and demoted from his supervisory role. Now forced to become the "Lychee Envoy," he faces a near-impossible mission to deliver fresh lychees from Lingnan to Chang'an as a birthday gift for the Noble Consort. The saying goes that lychees change color in one day, lose their fragrance in two, and their flavor in three days. With more than 5,000 li between Lingnan and Chang'an, and under tight deadlines with limited resources, how can he possibly pull it off?

name: The Unexpected Marriage
summary: Liu Chang Sheng is a beautiful princess from Fuyu. She is optimistic, cheerful, quick-witted and has a sharp tongue. Since childhood, she reads poetry and books, understands righteousness, and aspires to become a woman who does not lose to men. However, she causes strange bad luck to men who comes near her. They would get either drowned or get their leg broken. This makes it difficult for her to get married as most men rejects her.

name: Created in China
summary: In the late 1990s, Liu Jun who studied in Germany returns to his hometown of Donghai. Following the tide of the times, he is determined to modernize his father's old machinery factory with leading technology. As a private enterprise, Liu Jun struggles to acquire capital, connections, and technology.

name: Girls, Let's Defy Fate
summary: Two girls, Cai Xiao'ai, who is battling a terminal illness, and Gu Eun Zhao, a cold and distant girl, come together despite their fates. As they struggle with life's challenges, friendship, family, love, and their future, a hidden conspiracy begins to unravel around them.

name: She Is Still Cute Today
summary: "I'm into someone." Cang Shu, a straight-A student who always indulges in learning and has no passion for social contact, actually announces in public that she likes the poor student Qi Lin?! Thanks to a misunderstanding, the two of them begin to get to know each other. When a girl who disdains to make friends meets another girl who desires to be loved, what will occur between them?

name: Desejos S.A.
summary: Whatever, Whenever promises to fulfill any wish, at any time, for just $9.90 and a task: help with someone else's wish, whatever it may be.

name: Black & White Forest
summary: The story follows police officer Wen Binbin, who, with the support and assistance of team leader Xing Liang, embarks on a determined journey to find his lost service pistol. Despite numerous challenges, he remains steadfast in his pursuit of the truth and eventually captures the mastermind behind the scenes.

name: Sword Rose
summary: Deng Yan accidentally disrupts a police operation while rescuing a trafficked girl and becomes the new anti-trafficking office director. Chang Rui, a former undercover detective, is initially unhappy with her lack of experience. However, Deng Yan proves her abilities and earns his respect. Despite personal challenges, Chang Rui reaffirms his commitment to combating human trafficking. Driven by the disappearance of a childhood friend, Deng Yan uses new technology to solve old cases. As she uncovers a large trafficking network, she feels increasing responsibility. Despite facing dangers and crises, she persists in seeking the truth. After clearing her name, she leads her team against the trafficking ring's powerful forces.

name: Into the Heat
summary: Young and idealistic Liu Ziming joins a police division to fight crime, only to find routine investigative work far duller than expected. But as he gains field experience, he grows into a shrewd detective, mentoring newcomers while solving complex cases. Through many investigations, Liu confronts humanity's duality-the good and evil within-evolving into an exceptional captain. His mentor and comrades teach him the weight of a detective's duty. Now, safeguarding justice becomes his pride.

name: Sowers of Hope
summary: In 2002, newly graduated An Yan was assigned to teach at Heping Middle School in Changzhi County. Initially struggling to adapt to the rural environment and educational philosophy, she gradually came to value the significance of rural education and the sense of "being needed" through her interactions with students and home visits. Inspired by former principal Yu Tian and current principal Fu Shengzhi, An Yan embraced and carried forward the educational principles of "preservation" and "nurturing," becoming a well-regarded teacher. By 2012, An Yan had advanced to vice principal, overseeing logistics and successfully implementing the "nutritional lunch" program. In 2016, she was appointed principal of a relocated poverty alleviation school. Despite facing challenges with a weak teaching foundation and complex student backgrounds, An Yan and a team of dedicated rural teachers tackled each issue, creating a quality learning environment for the students. Like An Yan, rural educators tirelessly work to help students from mountain villages reach new heights.

name: Svenska Truckers
summary: Following professional truckdrivers around the clock delivering different types of cargo across the county - north to south

name: Young Again
summary: Six college students with contrasting personalities begin an internship at a senior care community. Through close interactions and daily observations, their preconceptions about aging are challenged as they discover the residents' enduring vitality, surprising perspectives, and wealth of life experience, along with a playful, childlike spirit. Over one semester, their views transform, and they become true "across‑age friends" to the community's beloved grandparents.

name: The Tale of Xishi: Kingdom Rebuilt
summary: In 494 B.C., the Kingdom of Wu defeated the Kingdom of Yue. King Goujian of the Kingdom of Yue became a slave and was humiliated for three years in the Wu Palace. After returning to his kingdom, Goujian endure countless hardship, utilized loyal talents Wen Zhong and Fan Li, and fought to revive the kingdom. Wen Zhong presented "Nine Strategies to Bring Down Wu". And Xishi, an ordinary washer girl bid farewell to her lover Fan Li and went to Wu with the intention of not being a conquered people. While the King of Wu, Fuchai and the ministers were wary of Goujian and repeatedly tested him, Xishi was always able to notice and warn them. She cooperated with Fan Li and the others, so that they could survive the danger. While the Kingdom of Yue was secretly gathering popular support, the Kingdom of Wu was instead boasting of its achievements, colonizing infinitely, and the power of the two kingdoms had become evenly matched. Goujian finally seized the opportunity as Fuchai fought for hegemony north to Huangchi, to conquer the Kingdom of Wu's capital Gusu and bring about the revival of the kingdom. Deferring to history, the story also tells the legend of Xishi and Fan Li's romance and sacrifice for the sake of the kingdom.

name: Hero is Back
summary: It's a story about Cao Yanbing, the descendant of Cao Cao, strong as the God of War, Xia Ling, who has a mysterious guardian spirit following her, and Beiluo Shimen, the former Spirit-Subduing General, going to the Forest of Emptiness to find the ancient Luhua Building with different agendas. It is a dangerous journey, but they support each other, overcome difficulties together, and finally become mature. However, they also find some shocking secrets...

name: City of the City
summary: The young man from the small town, Tao Wujie, was accepted into the Binjiang branch of Shenmao Bank, starting from the very bottom as a teller. His girlfriend, Tian Xiaohui, a Shanghai girl, entered a trust company through the introduction of her cousin. The two vowed to make great strides in the financial industry and strive to establish themselves in Shanghai as soon as possible. Tao Wujie, diligent and capable, stood out and was spotted and carefully mentored by the branch manager Zhao Hui and the audit director Miao Che, gradually finding his purpose and direction in his banking work; while Xiaohui, after entering the trust capital, brutally fought for survival, climbing up step by step only to discover that in this world of money, the two faced various challenges and tests. Wujie and Xiaohui, Zhao Hui and Miao Che, two generations of financial workers in the city, experienced career choices and fluctuations in fate. Facing temptations and dilemmas, they needed to make choices time and again: to go with the flow or to remain true to their original aspirations and end well?

name: Просто Надія
summary: Just Hope is a melodrama about a mother of 3 children who, due to the start of a full-scale war, is forced to leave her home for the sake of her family's safety. In a difficult time, without the support of her husband and money, she moves to another city, where she starts a new life and takes the first steps towards realizing her dream - to become a successful baker-confectioner.

name: Cult Justice
summary: Cult Justice explores the magnetic power of criminal cult leaders—and the dramatic investigations that finally brought them to justice.

name: Leh Nang Hong
summary: Manow was born into a wealthy family, but she got kidnapped as a baby by her aunt who was jealous that she'll receive the majority of the inheritance. She left Manow in the slums and was about to kill her when Jarunee found them. The aunt left in a hurry. Jarunee then took the baby as her own and raised her. Years later, Manow works in several jobs in order to feed her family. When fate leads her to meet Suruk, a millionaire, they don't get along at first but they eventually fall in love. Will he be able to find her biological parents?

name: Detektiverna
summary: Detectives Anis Don Demina, Kristina "Keyyo" Petrushina, Morgan Alling, Arantxa Álvarez, Nassim Al Fakir, Nisse Hallberg and Sussie Eriksson are faced with clever assignments. Who will do best and be crowned this year's master detective?

name: Saeng Soon
summary: Tiraka is a dangerous woman who can do anything to be the princess of the prestigious and enchanting Sang Soon Palace. She gets engaged to the heir of Sang Soon, Prince Aysoon Suriyachat, or "Thong". The engagement enrages Prince Pasaworn Suriyachat, or "Thoi", the jealous twin brother of Prince Aysoon, who feels that Tiraka is rightfully his.

name: Rostiga roadtrips
summary: Anders Ankan Johansson and Valle Westesson buy cars for a maximum of 10,000 bucks and drive them to the place where they were once built.

name: 112 Feuerwehr im Einsatz
summary: They rescue seriously injured accident victims from wrecked cars and battle blazing flames. The emergency responders at the fire stations in Iserlohn, Lünen, Dresden, Potsdam, Hildesheim, and Chemnitz must work with absolute concentration, because in acutely dangerous situations, every mistake can have fatal consequences. The series follows the lifesavers in their strenuous daily work. Body cameras capture critical situations from the firefighters' perspective. This perspective provides a particularly realistic portrayal of dramatic events, such as extinguishing a fire in a smoke-filled apartment.

name: Freddie Starr Variety Madhouse
summary: Comedy and variety show which also features Russ Abbot and Bella Emberg

name: Two of a Kind
summary: Original Morecambe and Wise show which aired on the ITV Network between 1961 and 1968.

name: Raeng Rit Pit Sawad
summary: A love triangle from a past life is set to happen again in this life. Praewa is a creative girl with high determination in her work. When she meets Peem, a rising young model, she was struck by his face from the moment she saw his photo. She felt connected to him, like they've known each other before. Praewa offers to be the one to conceptualize the album for Peem. She also received an appointment from the owner of the cable TV that Peem signed a contract with to go watch him at the hotel. When she arrived, Praewa met Nin, who was a fan of Peem.

name: Haru wo Daiteita
summary: Kyousuke Iwaki and Youji Katou who are both in the film industry, having starred in various adult video films and are trying to climb the ladder of success and become greater actors. Iwaki is accepted to star in a popular movie, having beaten Katou in the auditions. During their time together, Katou believes he is in love with Iwaki-San, who on the contrary refuses to believe that he is in love. It is later on that another gay actor comes back to Japan and co-stars with Katou that problems starting arising. And it is from then on that the two realize where their hearts are set.

previousepisode.name: A Cicada in Winter: Tokyo Tragedy

name: Brigade anonyme
summary: A former outlaw and big-hearted father, Castaneda has not always been on the good side of life. Today he has only one goal: to give the best to his daughter. But when his daughter disappears, he breaks the rules to find her. The first hours are decisive and the police stations are understaffed so Castaneda will investigate in his own way: surrounded by people like him, anonymous people, without privileges or diplomas, they will crisscross the countryside to track down the kidnapper.

name: The Invisible Shield
summary: The Invisible Shield, a four-part documentary series, reveals a little-known truth: that public health saved your life today and you probably don't even know it. But while public health makes modern life possible, the work itself is often underfunded, undervalued, and misunderstood.

name: Next Baking Master: Paris
summary: Next Baking Master: Paris gives ten ambitious and highly-skilled American bakers unprecedented access to the most iconic pastry shops, as well as mentoring from renowned French baking experts. The series demands that competitors prove their mettle in the pillars of great baking and pastry: technique, artistry, flavor, innovation, and inspiration. Each week, the lowest performing baker will be sent home -- until only one is named Next Baking Master.

name: Michael Palin in Nigeria
summary:
In his latest epic adventure, Michael Palin embarks on a 1300-mile journey across Nigeria.

Known as ‘The Giant of Africa', within 50 years Nigeria will be the third most populated country in the world after India and China. And while claims of corruption and fraud have blighted the country he also finds a very different Nigeria - stunning nature, diverse cultures and fascinating people. From the chaotic energy of Lagos to Islamic history in Kano and the tropical landscapes of the south, yet in some areas the spectre of terrorism remains. For Michael, at 80 years old, it may well turn out to be the most prophetic journey of his life.

name: Weird Britain
summary: Series exploring the weird history, weird legends and weird locations of the UK.

name: Stable: The Boxing Game
summary: Every fight can be make or break. Take a ringside seat at the McGuigans' boxing stable – where discipline, dedication and determination are the route to the top.

name: Paul O'Grady's Great Elephant Adventure
summary:
This two-part series follows the late Paul O'Grady as he travels through Thailand and Laos to celebrate the wonderful work done by elephant conservation centres to rescue, rehabilitate and protect these most majestic, but vulnerable, of animals. Filmed in the months before his sudden and unexpected death, this was Paul's final TV project and one that he was incredibly passionate about.

Thailand has the largest number of elephant rescue centres in the world, while Laos is nicknamed the ‘land of a million elephants', and in each episode, Paul travels across the region to roll up his sleeves and muck in to help out at a different rescue centre.  Along the way, Paul also heads out from the sanctuaries to grab a slice of local life by exploring nearby colourful markets, temples and apothecaries and trying local cuisine.  

The series highlights challenges faced by elephants in the region and as ever, Paul's love for animals shines throughout. The tone is warm, playful and heartfelt and always characterised by his much-loved wit and humour.

name: Утро ТНТ
summary:
TNT TV channel is reinventing the format of the morning program. Every morning on weekdays from 7 to 9 a.m., the audience will be greeted by presenters Anna Khilkevich and Anatoly Tsoi, as well as their guests. The project "MORNING. TNT is designed to become the most useful and modern morning on Russian television, because it will reflect all current and popular trends, topics and agendas. TNT will create a unique mix of television and digital, in which there will be a place for both TV masters and fresh faces. Communication with guests, capacious and modern headings, riles, shorts and telegram posts in a new format – all this is "MORNING. TNT."

The leading columns in the new show will be writer and journalist Sergey Minaev, psychotherapist Andrey Kurpatov, chef Mirko Dzago, powerlifter and world record holder Kirill Sarychev, oncologist Alexander Dzidzaria and many others.

name: Wo De Yi Jie Zhi Lu
Tommy Zoom
summary: Tommy Zoom and Daniel protect the world from the evil schemes of Polluto.

name: The Prince and the Pauper
summary: A poor boy named Tom Canty and Edward, the Prince of Wales exchange identities but events force the pair to experience each other's lives as well.

name: Plub Plerng See Chompoo
summary: Lily is the daughter of a rich businessman. She meets Witsarut and falls in love with him. She then pretends to be poor and rents a room from Witsarut and his friends. She tells Witsarut her name is Plub Pleung which is just the Thai translation of Lily. However, Witsarut works for her dad. So throughout the whole lakorn she's putting on all sorts of disguises as Lily so that he won't know Lily the boss' daughter is the same person as Plub Pleung.

name: Dao Lhong Fah
summary: Wan is a spoiled young girl from a rich family with a grandmother, mother and two aunts. She never received love or care from her father since she was young and her mother always told her that her father was a bad man who left her mother to be with another wife. Wan has always disliked her father. Dom is the grandson of the eldest lady who is a maid in the house and they are respected by Wan's family because they have been there for a very long time. Wan and Dom grew up together and she loves to trick and tease him. However he seems to always tease her back, as both are strong headed towards each other. Once Wan graduated she entered the entertainment industry as her mother pleased and became a popular actress. She started to meet various men and was forced to spend some time with her father and stepmother.

name: Nakak Dok Son Klin
summary: Saenpoom returns quickly from overseas when he learns that his father, San, has died of a serious heart attack after vacationing on the beach with Maleewan. His young wife was just on vacation.

name: Mekong
summary: A joint Thai-American company builds a bridge across the Mekong River. Construction works disturbed the ancient inhabitant of those waters, namely the Serpent, which began to kill the workers. Dave Chon, at the request of the head of the company, comes to the site and tries to understand the situation. He helps Kim, who is doing research in that area. They go on an expedition to the Mekong, where they find a tribe living alone. Residents of the tribe told that the Serpent lives in a cave and protects treasures. This was learned by the military, who also equipped their expedition. As a result of their actions, the entrance through the caves to the tribe was blown up and Kim stayed there. Dave, completing the bridge and with hope in his heart, went in search of Kim. At the entrance to the cave, he encounters the Serpent. Will the ancient deity answer the pleas of Dave for help?

name: Sarb Dok Soi
summary: A story of a young dancer who allowed a ghost to possess her body in an exchange to save her father's life. The ghost uses her body to catch preys. She must endure the suffering of her bloody hands. When she meets a young officer and both fall in love with each other, but he will misunderstand that she is the one that killed his father but when in truth, it was the ghost that possessed her. A story that insinuate true love comes with sacrifice.

name: Fudêncio e Seus Amigos
summary: The series shows the daily life and bizarre adventures of a group of student children who are friends with a punk, mean and monosyllabic boy named Fudêncio. The drawing takes place in the fictitious school E.E.P.S.G. José Mojica Marins, probably located in São Paulo. The rating is recommended for ages 16+.

name: The Two Faces of Thatri
summary: Thatri Thatriphan has gone bankrupt due to his extravagant spending and luxurious lifestyle. He has nothing, not even his house to his name. He doesn't even have anybody to rely on as both his lover and his friends have cut him off after he became bankrupt. One day while travelling by train, he chances to meet an old friend also named Thatri. This Thatri was once poor but has now become one of the heirs of a millionaire whose asset he is on his way to inherit.

name: Dahlia in Bloom
summary: After dying of overwork in Japan, Dahlia is reborn into a world filled with magic. Raised by a master of magical toolmaking, she develops a passion for the craft and becomes engaged to her father's apprentice. Before her father can see her wed, however, he suddenly passes away. As if this weren't enough, on the day before their wedding, her fiancé announces that he's in love—but not with her! Dahlia finally realizes she needs to live for herself. She vows to be her own woman from now on and devote herself to her craft, even if it's not quite the quiet life she was hoping for! From a chance encounter with a knight to starting her own company, there are challenges aplenty on the horizon. But this young craftswoman is no longer a shrinking violet—she's Dahlia, and she's ready to bloom.

name: Jack Whitehall: Fatherhood with My Father
summary: Jack has everything to learn about becoming a parent, while his dad thinks he knows it all. Together, they set off to explore the meaning of fatherhood.

name: The Beast in Me
summary: Since the tragic death of her young son, acclaimed author Aggie Wiggs has receded from public life, unable to write, a ghost of her former self. But she finds an unlikely subject for a new book when the house next door is bought by Nile Jarvis, a famed and formidable real estate mogul who was once the prime suspect in his wife's disappearance. At once horrified and fascinated by this man, Aggie finds herself compulsively hunting for the truth – chasing his demons while fleeing her own – in a game of cat and mouse that might turn deadly.

name: Memory in the Letter
summary: One day, an online novel about two people from two different worlds meeting through a mirror became the fascination of novel fans. However, it turns out to be based on Aksorn's life. Who is writing this story? How did the writer know Aksorn's personal story? It's the only clue that might lead him to reunite with the memories of the man from another parallel world. Follow the love story of two people across two different worlds and the miracles it entails.

name: Пацанки рулят
summary: For six weeks, the former tomboys will check in guests, clean rooms and work in the kitchen of a hotel near Moscow, and in their free time they will study entrepreneurship. Will the girls be able to keep their successful business afloat and how will the experiment of turning tomboys into businesswomen end?

name: Senpai wa Otokonoko
summary:
Makoto Hanaoka, a womanly second-year student, easily attracts other people's attention. First-year student Saki Aoi is no exception, and she falls in love with Makoto at first sight. Having a vibrant and vigorous personality, she does not hesitate to confess her feelings to her senior. However, Makoto differs significantly from the person Saki perceives: Makoto is not a girl, but rather a cross-dressing boy!

After revealing his well-known secret to Saki, Makoto expects her to be disgusted. Surprisingly, she is instead captivated by this revelation. Nonetheless, he still rejects her, but Saki's determination does not stop her from declaring that she will become his first love. With Saki and his childhood friend at his side, Makoto's world brightens, giving him strength amid his struggle between his interests and the expectations placed on him.

name: Talking Tom Shorts
summary: They may be called shorts, but they are definitely not short on the fun. Join the worldwide sensations, Talking Tom and Friends, in their fast paced, laugh-a-minute series where your favorite games come to life before your very eyes! Tune in to watch their hilarious adventures and get ready to smile on repeat!

name: The Wacky Adventure of Ronald McDonald
summary: The Wacky Adventures of Ronald McDonald centers on McDonald's mascot Ronald McDonald and the gang in McDonaldland.

name: Podly: The Peacemaker Podcast
summary: An HBO Max podcast for the Peacemaker show created by James Gunn. Hosts Ify Nwadiwe and Fiona Nova are here to guide you through the official, fan-driven companion podcast for HBO Max and DC's Peacemaker. They'll be sure to recap every laugh out loud moment, every kick ass action scene, and every tug on the heartstrings. And they'll be talking to some of the cast and creatives behind the show!

name: In Touch with Dr. Charles Stanley
summary: Dr Charles Stanley, pastor of the First Baptist Church in Atlanta, shares his insights on Christian faith and enlightens viewers with spiritual motivation.

name: Dessiner pour résister
summary: A documentary series about female cartoonists from all around the globe, challenging the red lines and taboos of their society. In search of people who experience their drawings in reality, they take us on a bold journey into their world.

name: Old Tom
summary: Old Tom is a one-eyed, flea-ridden, orange tomcat, who's good-natured but slothful behaviour is in contrast to the respectable, suburban matron, Angela Throgmorton, who treats Old Tom as if he were her son. They are, in reality, every bit as oddball and eccentric as each other, and together they become involved in a series of comedic adventures and topsy-turvy situations.

name: Whatever Turns You On
summary: A kid-based sketch comedy, aimed at 9-16 year olds. It was a national spinoff of the already popular local show You Can't Do That on Television (YCDTOTV), which had debuted a few months earlier. Whatever Turns You On (WTYO) featured seven of the 22 kids used on the first season of YCDTOTV and was shot on the same sets. Essentially they were the same show, only WTYO had comedy and musical guests, and YCDTOTV had those plus local, call-in features, and local contests.

name: Auto B. Good
summary: In every child's imagination, the inanimate come to life. What if it was possible for those creations to become a reality and teach important life lessons? There is such a place, the little City of Auto, just off of County Road "B" in the State of Good.

name: Pla Lhong Fah
summary: Because of the loyalty to the company, which is embedded in blood and every cell of Massaya, she has to accept the role of assistant to Naan Fah, the young president of a chips company who is good-for-nothing. She has to help him salvage the company's sales within three months, otherwise, his chairman position might slip into the hands of others. A mission to reclaim the chairmanship is tough enough, but she must act as a nanny to control his behavior too, since he always goes astray if a pretty girl comes near. Because he is a lonesome boy, she has to act as his girlfriend, so that he will be in sight at all times. But he likes to flirt her a lot. Despite knowing that she should not fall in love with this fun-loving guy, her heart is shaken.

name: Song Thoranong
summary: When the family inheritance is about to be taken over by greedy people. The two mill heir brothers rose up to fight. To protect the family and prove your worth.

name: Dok Bua Kao
summary: The main plot line of "Dok Bua Kao" is derived from a legend about a wealthy woman with a pure heart from centuries ago, who sacrificed all her worldly possessions to help the poor. She eventually dies out of starvation near a swamp. As legend goes, her body is then morphed into a lotus plant. In modern times, in buddhist culture, the lotus is used for worship for that reason, because it represents the highest order of sacrifice and purity.
